title: Koh Samet: real boats, straight chairs, a 3D taxi ride
kaylee: A jet ski and longtail boats that look like the real ones, loungers and beach-bar awnings that sit straight, and a ride in the green taxi with the family in the back instead of a flat cartoon.
questions: The taxi ride is now a little film of about 7 seconds (a hold on ⏭ skips it). Is that the right length, or should it be shorter?

pictures.title: The jet ski
pictures.caption: A pointed V bow, a red lower hull with a gold pinstripe, a hood with a visor and mirrors, a stepped seat

pictures.title: The snorkel boat
pictures.caption: A Thai longtail: a high prow with ribbons, the long-tail engine, a fringed canopy, benches and tyre fenders

pictures.title: Loungers and the beach bar
pictures.caption: Backs tip up behind the bed and awnings hang straight on every beach (they were twisting sideways)

pictures.title: Ao Prao
